subject: math
question: 已知锐角 $\triangle ABC$ ，若取点 $P(x, y)$ ，令 $f(x, y) = |AP| + |BP| + |CP|$ （ $|\cdot|$ 表示线段的长度）。证明在 $f(x, y)$ 取极值的点 $P_0$ 处，向量 $\overrightarrow{P_0A}, \overrightarrow{P_0B}, \overrightarrow{P_0C}$ 所夹的角相等。

steps.text:
分析 为便于讨论，需写出 $f(x, y)$ 的坐标表达式，由 $P_0$ 一定是 $f$ 的驻点可得 $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\bigg|_{P_0} = \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\bigg|_{P_0} = 0$ ，根据该关系式去讨论几个向量夹角的余弦，并说明它们相等.

设 $A, B, C$ 三点的坐标为 $(x_{i}, y_{i})(i = 1, 2, 3)$ ，极值点 $P_{0}$ 的坐标为 $(x_{0}, y_{0})$ ，则

$$
\overrightarrow {P _ {0} A} = \left(x _ {1} - x _ {0}, y _ {1} - y _ {0}\right), \quad \overrightarrow {P _ {0} B} = \left(x _ {2} - x _ {0}, y _ {2} - y _ {0}\right), \quad \overrightarrow {P _ {0} C} = \left(x _ {3} - x _ {0}, y _ {3} - y _ {0}\right),
$$

又 $f(x,y) = \sum_{i = 1}^{3}\sqrt{(x - x_i)^2 + (y - y_i)^2}$ ，得

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} \frac {x - x _ {i}}{\sqrt {(x - x _ {i}) ^ {2} + (y - y _ {i}) ^ {2}}}, \\ \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {3} \frac {y - y _ {i}}{\sqrt {(x - x _ {i}) ^ {2} + (y - y _ {i}) ^ {2}}}. \end{array} \right.
$$

以上两式两边平方再相加，得

$$
\cos \left(\overrightarrow {P _ {0} B}, \overrightarrow {P _ {o} C}\right) = \frac {\left(x _ {0} - x _ {2}\right) \left(x _ {0} - x _ {3}\right) + \left(y _ {0} - y _ {2}\right) \left(y _ {0} - y _ {3}\right)}{\sqrt {\left(x _ {0} - x _ {2}\right) ^ {2} + \left(y _ {0} - y _ {2}\right) ^ {2}} \sqrt {\left(x _ {0} - x _ {3}\right) ^ {2} + \left(y _ {0} - y _ {3}\right) ^ {2}}} = - \frac {1}{2}.
$$
同理 $\cos (\overrightarrow{P_0A},\overrightarrow{P_0B}) = \cos (\overrightarrow{P_0A},\overrightarrow{P_0C}) = -\frac{1}{2}$ 所以命题成立.
